name: Passed module that would also fail the language filter
description: Passed 'Compiler Construction' (which is German-only) AND restricted to German-only modules. Tests which exclusion reason wins when both would apply to the same module: the engine checks 'already passed' before the language filter, so this module must be excluded as 'already passed', never relabeled as a language mismatch. The other two English-only modules (core 'Software Architecture', core 'Foundations of Functional Programming') are excluded by language as in p05.
